maya_csm: Novacore weekly health (focus: p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs non-stream). Quick notes: overall traffic +15% (mobile feature rollout). Streaming p99 for /respond on redwood-60b jumped — visible UX regression. Snapshot below.

maya_csm: ```
Route | Model | Mode | p95(ms) | p99(ms)
/respond | redwood-60b | streaming | 360 | 740
/respond | redwood-60b | non-stream | 220 | 450
/brief | opt-6.7 | streaming | 160 | 320
/brief | opt-6.7 | non-stream | 130 | 250
/embed | embed-lite | n/a | 85 | 150
```

henry_cs_ops: Do we know when mobile rolled out? Any client changes that could explain longer prefixes?

maya_csm: Customer started gradual rollout on 2026-03-22; average prefix length up ~30 tokens. They pushed to 60% of users yesterday.

leo_infra: Infra signal: on nodes serving Novacore streams, KV cache hit rate fell from 70% -> 46% around 2026-03-22 18:40 UTC. We also saw elevated OOM-kicks in the stream-worker container on two older hosts.

tara_sre: Error rate stable (0.5%); no 5xx spike. But streaming queue latency spiked which contributes to p99. I'll add a short-lived dashboard alert: p99 > 700ms for >10m.

vikas_runtime: Possible root causes: increased prefix + reduced cache hit = more KV churn; streaming path keeps caches resident longer leading to memory pressure. Short-term fix: shift Novacore streaming to newer nodes with larger stream-worker memory and ensure kernel selection favors cu-opt where available.

leo_infra: I can cordon the two older hosts and migrate flows within 20m. Command I used: ```bash
infractl migrate-flows --customer novacore --route /respond --mode streaming --to-pool novacore-hot --wait 15m
```

notifier-bot: migration-op: started (id: mig-992).

maya_csm: Action items: 1) leo_infra 1h: complete migration and post KV hit rate. 2) vikas_runtime 32h: run 5% canary of a quantized redwood-60b streaming variant to measure p99 impact. 3) henry_cs_ops: prepare customer note saying we're actively mitigating and will follow-up with numbers.

leo_infra: Migration done. KV hit rate recovered to ~68% on hot pool after ~30m. Early latency update: p95 streaming 360 -> 310ms, p99 740 -> 520ms.

tara_sre: Alert fired briefly during migration, cleared. I've kept the watch rule active.

vikas_runtime: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-24T08:00Z (canary-id: qcan-47). Will post p95/p99 and a quick quality diff after 2h. If p99 improves >20% without quality loss, recommend increasing canary.

maya_csm: Renewal risk: currently medium due to customer-visible tail. If p99 stays >700ms for another week, we'll escalate to an exec update. For now, risk trending down with infra changes.

henry_cs_ops: Drafted the customer note in plain language: "we identified tail from streaming; routed your streaming traffic to nodes with higher memory and are running a canary; we expect further improvement within 24-48h." Will share before send.

maya_csm: Thanks team. Please update thread with canary results and I'll finalize the customer update.
